description: This file defines the Kubernetes RuntimeClass API objects, including the RuntimeClass, RuntimeClassSpec, Overhead, Scheduling, and RuntimeClassList, used for specifying container runtime configurations in a Kubernetes cluster.

classes.name: RuntimeClass
classes.description: Represents a class of container runtime supported in the cluster, used to specify runtime configurations for pods.

classes.name: RuntimeClassSpec
classes.description: Contains parameters describing the RuntimeClass, including runtime handler, overhead, and scheduling constraints.

classes.name: Overhead
classes.description: Represents resource overhead associated with running a pod under a specific RuntimeClass.

classes.name: Scheduling
classes.description: Specifies scheduling constraints such as node selector and tolerations for nodes supporting the RuntimeClass.
